```cypher
MATCH (s:Set {set_num: '10785-1'})-[:HAS_INVENTORY]->(inv:Inventory)
WITH s, inv
ORDER BY inv.version DESC
LIMIT 1
MATCH (inv)-[r:HAS_PART]->(p:Part)
WHERE r.is_spare = false
WITH SUM(r.qty) AS direct_parts
MATCH (s:Set {set_num: '10785-1'})-[:HAS_INVENTORY]->(inv2:Inventory)
WITH s, inv2, direct_parts
ORDER BY inv2.version DESC
LIMIT 1
OPTIONAL MATCH (inv2)-[r2:CONTAINS_SET]->(ns:Set)
OPTIONAL MATCH (inv2)-[r3:CONTAINS_MINIFIG]->(mf:Minifig)
WITH direct_parts,
     COALESCE(SUM(r2.qty * ns.num_parts), 0) AS nested_set_parts,
     COALESCE(SUM(r3.qty * mf.num_parts), 0) AS minifig_parts
WITH direct_parts, nested_set_parts, minifig_parts,
     direct_parts + nested_set_parts + minifig_parts AS total_parts
RETURN ROUND((nested_set_parts + minifig_parts) * 100.0 / total_parts, 2) AS percentage;
```
